notes: #1 is a Nuremberg Chronicle portrait of Augustine of Ancona, not a town view. P1 alternatives: #7 (Andrea Lilli’s 1597 painted view, dim and a narrow strip) and #20 (photo of Danti’s Gallery of Maps fresco). #5 has the book gutter through the plate. #9, #10 and #12 have unclear dates (#12 is credited to Leonardo De Vegni, who died in 1801, yet dated 1845). #13 is dated only ‘after 1861’; #17 is a low-resolution detail. #15 (1889 woodcut panorama from Porta Pia) is a better general view than #16 but only 39 years after #14; swap it in for #16 if preferred. #18 is the 1860 siege.
